title: Nine Winters and One Song
subtitle: 文化传承 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化传承（历史社会与文化·文化传承与保护）
meta: 主题语境：文化传承（历史社会与文化·文化传承与保护）　|　核心词汇：culture　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 culture 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my great-aunt ① kept a culture that no museum in the province would have recorded, and she said the keeping was the whole of the inheritance. The ② culture, meaning the songs and not the buildings, ran nine winters and stayed unsung in public; culture, she said, is the only thing a family owns that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ culture in that valley had the same three songs against it, and the ④ culture at the end, meaning the one they sang for the dead and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wept at twice. Culture, my grandfather said, is nine parts memory and one part somebody willing to sing; my great-aunt said the singing is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the culture was the whole of the province, meaning the way of life and not the songs. The ⑥ culture, meaning the way of life and not any of that, is the only thing in a province that everybody claims and nobody describes; culture, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a song and a way of living. He said the way of living is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ culture had become a chapter in a report, and the report had become an argument about the three songs. The ⑧ culture of the whole thing, my great-aunt wrote in March, was one valley and nine winters of singing; culture, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sing. She said the singing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ culture I remember is the one at the end, which was recorded in 1974 and is still described as the oldest in the province. A ⑩ culture, my great-aunt said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being sung; every culture, she said, is a way of living that has agreed to look like a song. She said the way of living was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文化（指一个民族或地区的文化总称）
B. n. 文化（指那些歌谣本身，与那些建筑相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a culture 传承（保持）一种文化
D. n. 文化（指为亡者唱的那一种）
E. n. 文化；文化传承（抽象总称，指一家人的全部传承）
F. n. 文化（指报告里写到、被记录下来的那一个）
G. n. 文化（指整个地区公认的那一种生活方式）
H. n. 文化（指生活方式本身，抽象总称）

items.q: kept a culture that no museum in the province would have recorded
The culture, meaning the songs and not the buildings
the culture was the whole of the province
The culture, meaning the way of life
the culture had become a chapter in a report
The culture of the whole thing
A culture, my great-aunt said in 1976

answers.why: keep a culture 意为“传承（保持）一种文化”，1948 年姑婆守着一种全省没有一家博物馆会去记录的文化。
culture 意为“文化”，指那些歌谣本身而不是那些建筑，它延续了九个冬天而从未公开唱过。
culture 意为“文化”，指那条山谷里每一种文化，每一种都有同样的三首歌。
culture 意为“文化”，指为亡者唱的那一种，是唯一有人为之落过两次泪的。
culture 意为“文化”，指整个地区公认的那一种生活方式，叔叔说这种文化就是全省的全部。
culture 意为“文化”，指生活方式本身而不是别的，是一个地区里人人都宣称拥有、却无人能描述的那种东西。
culture 意为“文化”，指报告里写到、被记录下来的那一个，到 1961 年这种文化成了报告里的一章。
culture 意为“文化、文化传承”，姑婆三月写道，整件事的文化传承是一条山谷和九个冬天的歌唱。
culture 意为“文化”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1974 年被记录下来，至今仍被说成全省最古老的。
culture 为抽象总称，姑婆 1976 年说，一种文化是唯一会因为被传唱而变得更好的东西。
